quests.title: Economic Policy Advisor Challenge
quests.description: Advise the government on macroeconomic policies and their impacts!

steps.title: Fiscal Policy Design Challenge
steps.narrative: The Finance Ministry needs your advice on fiscal policy during economic recession.

problem.question: During a recession, which fiscal policy measure would be most effective?
options: Increase taxes and reduce government spending
Decrease taxes and increase government spending
Increase taxes and increase government spending
problem.correct_answer: Decrease taxes and increase government spending
problem.explanation: Expansionary fiscal policy (lower taxes, higher spending) stimulates aggregate demand during recession.
